explication:
Purpose and principal workflow

UCP is a protocol-definition and documentation repository, not a commerce backend. The main workflow is initiated by a Commerce Platform / AI Agent: it reads a business’s published profile, discovers supported capabilities and service transports, then invokes catalog, cart/checkout, order, and optional payment flows through REST, MCP, or embedded interfaces. The repository supplies the schemas, transport contracts, payment declarations, and documentation tooling needed for those integrations.

Components

Protocol discovery and domain model

  • UCP Root Model — source/schemas/ucp.json. Defines the root protocol vocabulary and entity structure used to validate UCP-authored declarations.
  • Profile Manifest — source/schemas/profile.json. Models a business profile through which platforms discover supported UCP functionality.
  • Capability Declarations — source/schemas/capability.json. Defines modular capabilities and their advertised configuration.
  • Service Declarations — source/schemas/service.json. Describes service exposure and transport-related metadata.
  • Common Commerce Types — source/schemas/common. Provides reusable identity, location, payment, amount, message, and extension types shared across vertical capabilities.
  • Catalog Contracts — source/schemas/shopping/catalog_search.json. Defines standardized product discovery and search payloads.
  • Cart and Checkout Contracts — source/schemas/shopping/checkout.json. Defines cart/checkout session operations, totals, fulfillment, consent, and completion data.
  • Order Contracts — source/schemas/shopping/order.json. Defines order representations and lifecycle-facing data.

Transport and payment interfaces

  • Transport Envelopes — source/schemas/transports. Defines protocol message envelopes for JSON-RPC, embedded, MCP, and related transports.
  • REST Shopping Interface — source/services/shopping/rest.openapi.json. Publishes the REST operation surface for shopping capabilities.
  • MCP Shopping Interface — source/services/shopping/mcp.openrpc.json. Publishes the MCP/OpenRPC shopping tool surface.
  • Embedded Shopping Interface — source/services/shopping/embedded.openrpc.json. Defines embedded/OpenRPC shopping interactions; the README also documents A2A as a supported transport family.
  • Payment Action Interface — source/services/payment-actions/embedded.openrpc.json. Defines embedded payment actions such as authentication or device-data collection.
  • Payment Handler Declaration — source/schemas/payment_handler.json. Defines the declaration structure for payment handlers.
  • Tokenization Handler Interface — source/handlers/tokenization/openapi.json. Specifies tokenization/payment-credential exchange operations.

Documentation and publication pipeline

  • Specification Corpus — docs/specification/overview/index.md. Anchors the published human-readable protocol specification; the broader documentation tree covers shopping, payment, identity, signatures, and extensions.
  • Schema Documentation Macros — main.py. Registers MkDocs macros that resolve schemas, dereference JSON pointers, and render operation-specific request/response field documentation.
  • Documentation Build Hooks — hooks.py. Rewrites schema references and versioned URLs, injects release metadata, filters root/spec builds, and copies schema artifacts to publication paths.
  • Example Validation Tool — scripts/validate_examples.py. Parses annotated JSON examples, reduces authoring conveniences to canonical JSON, and validates examples against resolved schemas.

External participants and tools

  • Commerce Platform / AI Agent — repository path: null. External caller that discovers businesses and performs agentic shopping interactions.
  • Business Commerce Implementation — repository path: null. External merchant/backend that publishes a profile and implements one or more UCP service surfaces.
  • Payment Service Provider / Credential Provider — repository path: null. External payment-side participant in token or credential exchange.
  • MkDocs — repository path: null. External documentation engine that invokes the macros and build hooks.
  • ucp-schema CLI — repository path: null. External resolver/validator invoked by the documentation and example-validation tooling.

Relationships

  • Commerce Platform / AI Agent -> Profile Manifest: reads the business’s published profile to initiate capability discovery; this is the README’s documented dynamic-discovery model.
  • Business Commerce Implementation -> Profile Manifest: publishes a declaration of supported capabilities and services.
  • UCP Root Model -> Profile Manifest: constrains the profile’s protocol entity structure.
  • Profile Manifest -> Capability Declarations: advertises the capabilities available to a platform.
  • Profile Manifest -> Service Declarations: advertises service exposure and transport choices.
  • Service Declarations -> REST Shopping Interface: identifies REST as one possible service surface.
  • Service Declarations -> MCP Shopping Interface: identifies MCP as an alternative service surface.
  • Service Declarations -> Embedded Shopping Interface: identifies embedded interaction as an alternative surface.
  • Commerce Platform / AI Agent -> REST Shopping Interface: invokes shopping operations when REST is selected.
  • Commerce Platform / AI Agent -> MCP Shopping Interface: invokes shopping tools when MCP is selected; this is an alternative, not an additional pipeline stage.
  • Commerce Platform / AI Agent -> Embedded Shopping Interface: uses embedded operations when that transport is selected.
  • Business Commerce Implementation -> REST Shopping Interface: implements the REST contract.
  • Business Commerce Implementation -> MCP Shopping Interface: implements the MCP contract where offered.
  • Business Commerce Implementation -> Embedded Shopping Interface: implements the embedded contract where offered.
  • Business Commerce Implementation -> Catalog Contracts: produces catalog/search responses for discovery.
  • Business Commerce Implementation -> Cart and Checkout Contracts: creates, updates, and completes checkout sessions.
  • Cart and Checkout Contracts -> Order Contracts: represents the order outcome of a completed checkout.
  • Common Commerce Types -> Cart and Checkout Contracts: supplies shared payment, identity, location, amount, and message structures.
  • Cart and Checkout Contracts -> Payment Action Interface: may require standardized payment actions during checkout.
  • Payment Handler Declaration -> Tokenization Handler Interface: connects declared payment-handler capabilities to tokenization operations.
  • Tokenization Handler Interface -> Payment Service Provider / Credential Provider: defines the external payment-token or credential exchange boundary.
  • Transport Envelopes -> MCP Shopping Interface: supplies shared message-envelope structures for MCP/OpenRPC interactions.
  • MkDocs -> Schema Documentation Macros: loads the macro entry point during documentation builds.
  • Schema Documentation Macros -> ucp-schema CLI: directly invokes schema resolution through subprocess calls.
  • MkDocs -> Documentation Build Hooks: invokes lifecycle hooks that transform files and build configuration.
  • Documentation Build Hooks -> UCP Root Model: rewrites schema identifiers, references, versions, and publication paths.
  • Example Validation Tool -> ucp-schema CLI: invokes schema resolution and validation for documentation examples.
  • Example Validation Tool -> Specification Corpus: scans annotated JSON examples and validates their canonicalized contents.

Coverage limits

The sampled inputs do not contain a merchant server, database, queue, authentication service, or concrete network routing implementation. The shopping and payment interface internals were not sampled, so those relationships describe documented contract boundaries rather than verified runtime call order. Checkout and order schemas are representations, not evidence of a repository-owned state store.
